name: access-management-portal
description: Local skeleton for the Access Management Portal pilot.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @access-portal/contracts && npm run build -w @access-portal/shared && npm run build -w @access-portal/connectors && npm run build -w @access-portal/database && npm run build -w @access-portal/web && npm run build -w @access-portal/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @access-portal/contracts && npm run build -w @access-portal/shared && npm run build -w @access-portal/connectors && npm run build -w @access-portal/database && npm run typecheck -w @access-portal/web && npm run typecheck -w @access-portal/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @access-portal/contracts && npm run build -w @access-portal/shared && npm run build -w @access-portal/connectors && npm run build -w @access-portal/database && npm run test -w @access-portal/connectors && npm run test -w @access-portal/database && npm run test -w @access-portal/web && npm run test -w @access-portal/api
